subject: ENGLISH
title: Detail Tracker · M01 D18
objective: Identify who, where, when, and what in a short original text.
introduction: Important details answer questions such as who, where, when, and what happened. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: A small piece of information in a story.
What a story or paragraph is mostly about.
A hint that helps you solve a mystery.
